findings.highlight: use your Command Spells to make your wish come true?
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪でイリヤの望みに応える
findings.governingReading: 俺 thinks he could respond to イリヤの望み through the Command Spell analogy.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s idea to fulfill Illya’s wish becomes second-person advice to fulfill your wish.

findings.highlight: It's too late to hang out today.
findings.evidenceJa: 今日の約束は守れない
findings.governingReading: He cannot retroactively keep 今日の約束, so proposes an alternative act now.
findings.explanation: The missed appointment being irretrievable becomes too late to hang out today.

findings.governingReading: Shirou lowers his back to look directly at Illya while swearing.

findings.highlight: I shouldn't keep doubting her courage.
findings.evidenceJa: そのありったけの勇気に、つまらない疑問なんて挟める筈がない
findings.governingReading: Her courageous disclosure makes his petty objections inappropriate.
findings.explanation: Not questioning her trivial-seeming request in the face of her courage becomes not doubting the courage itself.

findings.highlight: serve Illya the best I can, as her knight.
findings.evidenceJa: 精一杯彼女を守らないといけない
findings.governingReading: As her knight he must do his utmost to protect her.
findings.explanation: The knightly resolve to protect Illya becomes generic service.

findings.evidenceJa: 二人分のジュースを持って
findings.governingReading: The passage says she has both cans; page29 explicitly says her own can is the purchase she asked Shirou to make.
findings.explanation: The two drinks Illya carries become two drinks she bought.

findings.highlight: she told me my white hair was pretty.
findings.evidenceJa: 白くて女の子らしいって誉めてくれた
findings.governingReading: The giver of the praise is omitted; the next page separately stresses Shirou intuitively realizing who spoke.
findings.explanation: The remembered praise of Illya’s hair is explicitly attributed to her mother.

findings.highlight: From the perspective of Kiritsugu's son, she's a child who's been chasing after a man who has nothing to do with her.
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の息子として、その背中を追い続けた無縁の子供
findings.governingReading: The child is Shirou: originally unrelated to Kiritsugu, he followed his example as his son.
findings.explanation: Shirou's description of himself as the unrelated child who became Kiritsugu's son is reassigned to Illya. His reflection on following his adoptive father is lost.
